sections.open.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities anyone can find and join.

sections.invited.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities only invited people can open.

sections.solo.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the projects that have no member but this person.

sections.open.noun.description: What one community anyone can find and join is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.invited.noun.description: What one community only invited people can open is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.solo.noun.description: What a project with no member but this person is called, naming its audience. It stands where "Public community" or "Private community" would.

sections.open.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.open.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.solo.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.solo.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.shownOf_one.description: Number beside a section heading in the list of the person's communities, while the section is folded: how many of its communities are listed out of how many it has, as in "3 of 27". {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOf_other.description: Number beside a section heading in the list of the person's communities, while the section is folded: how many of its communities are listed out of how many it has, as in "3 of 27". {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOfLabel_one.description: Accessible name of the "3 of 27" number beside a folded section heading in the list of the person's communities. The heading's own name says which section. {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOfLabel_other.description: Accessible name of the "3 of 27" number beside a folded section heading in the list of the person's communities. The heading's own name says which section. {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.showFewer.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities, once every community in it is showing: folds the section back to its first few rows.

sections.showMore_one.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

sections.showMore_other.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

row.toVote_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

row.toVote_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

needsYou.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the row of filter chips above the Needs you feed (All, Votes that decide, Advisory), which narrows the votes waiting on the person to one kind.

needsYou.filter.all.description: Filter chip above the Needs you feed: shows every vote waiting on the person, whether their vote decides it or is advisory.

needsYou.filter.deciding.description: Filter chip above the Needs you feed: shows only the votes that count toward whether a change goes in.

needsYou.filter.advisory.description: Filter chip above the Needs you feed: shows only the changes where the person's vote is recorded but does not decide the outcome.

needsYou.filter.allCount_one.description: Accessible name of the All filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.allCount_other.description: Accessible name of the All filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.decidingCount_one.description: Accessible name of the Votes that decide filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many of the person's votes decide their outcome. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.decidingCount_other.description: Accessible name of the Votes that decide filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many of the person's votes decide their outcome. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.advisoryCount_one.description: Accessible name of the Advisory filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many advisory votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

needsYou.filter.advisoryCount_other.description: Accessible name of the Advisory filter chip above the Needs you feed, with how many advisory votes wait on the person. {{count}} is that number.

reel.fallbackTitle.change.description: Stands in for the title of a proposal (a change to a project put up for a vote) in the Needs you feed when the proposal has no title.

reel.fallbackTitle.decision.description: Stands in for the title of a group decision (a vote on a project's settings, such as a rename, rather than on a code change) in the Needs you feed when it has no title.

reel.ask.change.description: Question over the Yes and No buttons of a proposal in the Needs you feed: asks whether the proposed change should be merged into the project.

reel.ask.decision.description: Question over a group decision in the Needs you feed: asks whether the decision (for example a rename of the project) should be carried out.

reel.fallbackTitle.question.description: Stands in for the words of a question Homeroom bot asked the person about their request, in the Needs you feed, when the question has none.

reel.ask.ballot.description: Question on an item of the Needs you feed that holds competing changes for one request (and maybe a proposal to close it): the person picks one on the request's page.

reel.ask.question.text: Homeroom bot asked you about your request
reel.ask.question.description: Question on an item of the Needs you feed that is a question Homeroom bot asked the person about their request: they answer it on the request's page.

reel.ballot.choice.description: One choice of competing changes, in the list on an item of the Needs you feed. {{letter}} is the change's letter (A, B, C) as the request's page letters it, {{title}} its title.

reel.ballot.close.description: Last choice in the list of competing changes on an item of the Needs you feed, when a proposal to close the request competes with them.

reel.ballot.choices.description: Line on an item of the Needs you feed that holds competing changes: its choices, joined as a list. {{choices}} is that list.

reel.ballot.fallbackTitle.description: Title of an item of the Needs you feed that holds competing changes, when the request they are for has no title. {{number}} is the request's number.

reel.pages.note.text: These are waiting on you. Each one is decided on its own page.
reel.pages.note.description: Line above the list on the Communities screen's Needs you when everything waiting is decided on its own page (a group decision, competing changes or a question from Homeroom bot) rather than in the review run.

reel.pages.governance.description: Second line of a row on the Communities screen's Needs you that opens a group decision's own page. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.pages.ballot.description: Second line of a row on the Communities screen's Needs you that opens a request's page, where competing changes for it are picked from. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.pages.question.description: Second line of a row on the Communities screen's Needs you that opens a request's page, where Homeroom bot asked a question. {{project}} is the project's name.

reel.pages.label.description: Accessible name of the list on the Communities screen's Needs you whose rows each open the page where that item is decided.

reel.yes.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes for the change going in.

reel.no.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes against the change going in.

reel.error.text: Couldn't load what is waiting on you. Each project's own Needs you page still has it.
reel.error.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when it could not be loaded. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page, which lists the same votes for that project.

reel.loading.description: Accessible name of the empty placeholder shown while the Needs you feed on the Communities screen is loading.

reel.empty.text: Nothing is waiting on your vote in any of your projects.
reel.empty.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen only when nothing at all is waiting for this person: no proposal, competing change, question or group decision.

reel.done.description: Button on the card at the end of the Needs you page (every vote waiting on the person across their projects): returns to Home, where their communities are.

reel.capped_one.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_one.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

reel.capped_other.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_other.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

switcher.title.description: Title of the switcher that lists every community the person belongs to, opened from the header's name or the Communities tab, for moving from one community to another.

switcher.all.name.description: First row of the Your communities switcher: leaves the single community being shown and opens the list of all of the person's communities.

switcher.all.count_one.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.count_other.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.every.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher while the list is still loading, so there is no count to show yet.

switcher.loading.description: Note in the Your communities switcher while the list of the person's communities is loading.

switcher.row.solo.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a project that has no member but this person.

switcher.row.invited_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.invited_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.toVote_one.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.toVote_other.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search field at the top of the Your communities switcher, which filters the person's communities by name as they type.

switcher.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Your communities switcher. It can also be reached with Command+K or Ctrl+K.

switcher.search.results.description: Accessible name of the list of communities whose names match what the person typed in the Your communities switcher's search.

switcher.search.none.description: Shown in the Your communities switcher when no community the person is in has the searched words in its name. {{query}} is what they typed.

switcher.recent.description: Small heading in the Your communities switcher over the communities the person used most recently (and the ones they pinned), above the All communities row.

switcher.join.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens Discover, where the person can find a community to join.

switcher.start.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens the dialog that creates a new project and its community.

review.end.line.description: Quiet line at the end of Needs you feed, under a check mark, once every waiting change has been shown.

review.end.throughAll.description: Title at the end of Needs you when the person skipped some changes without voting, so not everything is done. Shown over a small stack of the skipped changes.

review.end.waiting_one.text: 1 is still waiting for your vote.
review.end.waiting_one.description: Line under "You've been through them all" at the end of Needs you, when the person skipped one change without voting.

review.end.waiting_other.text: {{count}} are still waiting for your vote.
review.end.waiting_other.description: Line under "You've been through them all" at the end of Needs you, when the person skipped several changes without voting. {{count}} is how many.

review.end.again_one.description: Main button at the end of Needs you when one change was skipped: opens that change again so the person can vote.

review.end.again_other.description: Main button at the end of Needs you when several changes were skipped: goes through them again so the person can vote. {{count}} is how many.

review.thumbs.label.description: Accessible name of the row of small screen pictures under a change's before and after slider in Needs you flow.

review.thumbs.one.description: Accessible name of one small screen picture under a change's slider in Needs you flow. {{n}} is its position, {{total}} how many there are.

review.strip.all_one.description: Accessible name of the first tile in the strip under a change's picture (Needs you flow): it shows every screen of the change at once. {{count}} is how many screens.

review.strip.all_other.description: Accessible name of the first tile in the strip under a change's picture (Needs you flow): it shows every screen of the change at once. {{count}} is how many screens.

review.alt.after.description: Alt text of the after picture in a change's before and after slider (Needs you flow).

review.alt.before.description: Alt text of the before picture in a change's before and after slider (Needs you flow).

review.compare.label.description: Accessible name of the before and after slider on a change's page (Needs you flow). Drag sideways, or use the arrow keys, to compare.

review.compare.showingAfter.text: Showing the screen after the change
review.compare.showingAfter.description: Screen reader value of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen after the change.

review.compare.showingBefore.text: Showing the screen before the change
review.compare.showingBefore.description: Screen reader value of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen before the change.

review.compare.captionBefore.description: Caption printed at the top left of the before picture on a change's page (Needs you flow), in small capitals. <0> wraps the quieter part. Keep it very short.

review.compare.captionAfter.description: Caption printed at the top right of the after picture on a change's page (Needs you flow), in small capitals: the screen as it will be if the vote passes. <0> wraps the quieter part. Keep it very short.

review.compare.switch.text: Show the screen before the change
review.compare.switch.description: Accessible name of the small switch at the foot of the before and after picture (Needs you flow). On: the before screen fills the picture. Off: the after screen.

review.sheet.label.description: Accessible name of the vote sheet at the foot of a change's page (Needs you flow).

review.sheet.more.description: Accessible name of the small handle at the top of the vote sheet while it rests: tapping it opens the help (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it, About).

review.sheet.close.description: Accessible name of the small handle at the top of the vote sheet while it is open: tapping it folds the sheet back.

review.vote.yes.description: Button in the vote sheet on a change's page: vote for the change going live.

review.vote.no.description: Button in the vote sheet on a change's page: vote against the change. It asks for one line on what would make it a yes.

review.vote.approve.description: Yes button in the vote sheet on a change to a project that is just yours, where your yes is the one it needs.

review.vote.dontApprove.description: No button in the vote sheet on a change to a project that is just yours.

review.vote.skip.description: Button beside the Yes | No pair at the foot of a change's page in Needs you. It moves on to the next change at once without a vote; nothing is recorded and the change keeps waiting in Needs you. After a vote the same place shows Next. One word.

review.vote.skipLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the Skip button beside the Yes | No pair in Needs you. It moves on without a vote; the change keeps waiting in Needs you.

review.no.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the optional one-line box under the answers for a No vote's reason. {{name}} is the username of the person who made the change.

review.no.placeholderNoName.text: One line for whoever made it
review.no.placeholderNoName.description: Placeholder in the optional one-line box under the answers for a No vote's reason, when the change's maker is not known.

review.no.send.description: Button that sends a No vote, with the picked answer as its reason, in the vote sheet on a change's page (Needs you). It is off until an answer is picked.

review.reason.add.description: Quiet link above the vote buttons after someone voted No on a change (Needs you flow). It opens the sheet that asks why.

review.reason.label.description: Accessible name of the one-line field where someone adds a reason to their No vote (Needs you flow).

review.reason.share.description: Button inside the one-line reason field: sends the reason with the No vote (Needs you flow).

review.why.title.description: Heading of the sheet that asks why someone is voting No on a change (Needs you flow).

review.why.notWorking.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote: the change does not work.

review.why.approach.text: I do not agree with the approach
review.why.approach.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote: they disagree with how the change was made.

review.why.notNeeded.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote: the change is unnecessary.

review.why.other.description: Answer someone can pick as the reason for a No vote when none of the other answers fits; the optional line is where they say more.

review.why.detailLabel.description: Label over the optional one-line box under the answers for a No vote's reason.

review.why.withDetail.description: How a No vote's reason reads when the voter added a line: the picked answer, a colon, then the line. {{choice}} is the answer, for example "It does not work"; {{detail}} is the line they wrote.

review.said.yes.description: Title in the vote sheet after voting Yes, under a large check mark.

review.said.no.description: Title in the vote sheet after voting No, under a large mark.

review.said.undo.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting: takes the vote back while voting is still open.

review.desc.show.description: Accessible name of the ⌄ button beside the change's title at the top of Needs you flow: drops the change's full description over the page.

review.desc.hide.description: Accessible name of the same button while the change's full description is open (Needs you flow): folds it away.

review.desc.by.description: Small line under a change's description in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. {{name}} is the person who made the change.

review.help.label.description: Screen-reader name of the help rows (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it) at the foot of the card that opens from the bar of Needs you.

review.help.ask.description: Help row in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. Opens a private question to the AI about this change; only the person sees the answers.

review.help.talk.description: Help row in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. Opens the change's discussion thread: what others said about it.

review.help.try.description: Help row in the card that opens from the bar of Needs you. Opens a live copy of the app with this change, when one is running.

review.back.label.description: Accessible name of the back control at the top of Needs you flow. {{place}} is the place it goes back to: Home, or the project's name.

review.said.nextShort.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting (Needs you flow): moves sideways to the next change waiting on you. A small count in a ring follows it. Keep it one short word.

review.said.nextLeft_one.description: Accessible name of the Next button in Needs you flow, when one change still waits besides the one on screen. The button shows that number in a ring that fills as the run is decided.

review.said.nextLeft_other.description: Accessible name of the Next button in Needs you flow: {{count}} is how many changes still wait besides the one on screen, the number the button shows in a ring that fills as the run is decided.

review.said.done.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting on the last change without your vote: opens the all-done message, which says that nothing else is waiting and offers the way back to the list.

review.ask.note.text: Only you see this. Answers come from the change itself.
review.ask.note.description: Line at the top of Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.inAi.description: Button in the Ask privately sheet of a change waiting for the person's vote: opens their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) with this change attached, to ask about it there. "AI" is the tab's name.

review.ask.inAiNote.text: Ask Homeroom bot about this change in your private chat with it. The change comes with you, and only you see it.
review.ask.inAiNote.description: Line at the top of the Ask privately sheet of a change waiting for the person's vote, above the Ask Homeroom bot button: questions about the change are asked in the person's private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) now. "AI" is the tab's name.

review.ask.earlier.description: Small heading in the Ask privately sheet of a change, over the questions the person asked about it here before questions moved to the AI chat, and their answers. They can still be read.

review.ask.who.description: Name over an answer in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.q1.description: Suggested question in Ask privately in the vote sheet. Tapping it asks it.

review.ask.q2.description: Suggested question in Ask privately in the vote sheet. Tapping it asks it.

review.ask.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the question box in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.send.description: Button that sends a question in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.reading.description: Placeholder answer in Ask privately while the answer is on its way.

review.ask.failed.text: Couldn't get an answer just now. Try again in a moment.
review.ask.failed.description: Answer in Ask privately when the question could not be answered and the server gave no reason.

review.ask.offline.text: You seem to be offline. Try again when you're connected.
review.ask.offline.description: Answer in Ask privately when the question could not be sent.

review.try.note.text: A live copy with this change. Nothing you do there is kept.
review.try.note.description: Line on the Try it page of the vote sheet, over the button that opens the live copy.

review.try.open.description: Button on the Try it page of the vote sheet: opens the change's live preview.

review.try.none.text: There's no live copy of this change right now. Its page may be able to start one.
review.try.none.description: Line on the Try it page of the vote sheet when the change has no live preview.

review.more.open.description: Row in the vote sheet’s help, and a link in its About and Try it panels (Needs you flow): leaves the run for the change’s own page in its project.

review.benefit.fixed.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.stability.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.clarity.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.more.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.results.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.speed.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.effort.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.security.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.behind.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you: the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.area.agents.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.proposals.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.platform.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.projects.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.accounts.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.admin.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.messages.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.challenges.description: Label over a drawn picture in Needs you, after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.decision.closeIssue.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.decision.rename.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.decision.secret.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.decision.other.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in Needs you: what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.

review.end.backToProject.description: Button at the end of a project's Needs you in the review flow, once every waiting change has been shown: opens the project's Workshop.
